On 2026-11-11 the owner ordered every contrary instruction found and corrected, and the right way made explicit. It is written in
the repository, `log/how-we-work.md` (the eleven steps in the order they apply, and the table of contradictions settled that day),
with CLAUDE.md pointing to it. Where a memory, a record, a skill or an old plan says otherwise, those two win, and a new
contradiction is settled there in the same change.

**Why:** contrary memories (no "before" measurement, agents allowed, machine translation as a start, bless to pass) kept leading
the work wrong while the owner repeated the same orders.

**How to apply:** at the start of any task, the steps of `log/how-we-work.md`; before acting on a memory, check it does not
contradict them. Related: [[fix-cause-effort-neutral]], [[no-reference-game]], [[photos-follow-the-change]], [[never-wake-stopped-agents]].
